---
title: "Longitudinal Explorer"
---

Several Peekbank datasets tested the same children repeatedly. Each point is
one test session (administration); thin lines connect sessions from the same
child, showing individual developmental trajectories in recognition accuracy
and speed.

::: {.viz-sidebar}

```{ojs long-inputs}
longitudinalNames = manifest.datasets.filter((d) => d.longitudinal).map((d) => d.name)

viewof sel_datasets = Inputs.select(longitudinalNames, {
  label: "Datasets (longitudinal)", multiple: 8,
  value: ["adams_marchman_2018", "fernald_marchman_2012", "fernald_totlot", "fmw_2013"],
})
viewof measure = Inputs.select(["Accuracy", "Reaction time"], {
  label: "Measure", value: "Accuracy",
})
viewof analysis_window = interval([-1000, 4000], {
  step: 25, value: [250, 2250], label: "Accuracy window (msec)",
})
viewof log_age = Inputs.toggle({ label: "Log age axis", value: false })
viewof min_sessions = Inputs.range([1, 4], {
  step: 1, value: 2, label: "Min sessions per child",
})
viewof min_trials = Inputs.range([1, 10], {
  step: 1, value: 4, label: "Min trials per session",
})
viewof include_excluded = Inputs.toggle({
  label: "Lab-excluded trials", value: true,
})
```

:::

::: {.viz-main}

```{ojs long-data}
//| output: false
slices = Promise.all(sel_datasets.map(loadSlice))

adminMeasures = {
  const rows = buildRows(slices, { includeExcluded: include_excluded, collapseWords: true });
  const byAdmin = d3.group(rows, (r) => `${r.dataset}|${r.aid}`);
  const out = [];
  for (const [, g] of byAdmin) {
    const { dataset, aid, subject, age } = g[0];
    const accs = [];
    const rts = [];
    for (const r of g) {
      const a = windowAccuracy(r.t0, r.runs, analysis_window[0], analysis_window[1]);
      if (a != null) accs.push(a);
      const res = trialRT(r.t0, r.runs);
      if (res && res.rt != null && res.shift_type === "D-T") rts.push(res.rt);
    }
    out.push({
      dataset, aid, subject: `${dataset}|${subject}`, age,
      accuracy: accs.length >= min_trials ? d3.mean(accs) : null,
      n_acc_trials: accs.length,
      rt: rts.length >= Math.max(1, Math.floor(min_trials / 2)) ? d3.mean(rts) : null,
      n_rt_trials: rts.length,
    });
  }
  return out;
}

longData = {
  const field = measure === "Accuracy" ? "accuracy" : "rt";
  const pts = adminMeasures.filter((d) => d[field] != null && d.age != null);
  const bySubj = d3.group(pts, (d) => d.subject);
  const keep = new Set();
  for (const [s, g] of bySubj) if (g.length >= min_sessions) keep.add(s);
  return pts.filter((d) => keep.has(d.subject))
    .map((d) => ({ ...d, value: d[field] }))
    .sort((a, b) => a.age - b.age);
}

nChildren = new Set(longData.map((d) => d.subject)).size
```

```{ojs long-count}
html`<p style="color:#6b7280; margin:0 0 0.5rem 0">${nChildren.toLocaleString()}
children, ${longData.length.toLocaleString()} sessions
(≥${min_sessions} sessions each).</p>`
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Trajectories

```{ojs long-plot}
{
  document.querySelectorAll(".pb-spinner").forEach((el) => el.remove());
  const isAcc = measure === "Accuracy";
  return Plot.plot({
    width, height: 520, grid: true,
    x: { label: "Age (months)", type: log_age ? "log" : "linear" },
    y: isAcc
      ? { label: "Proportion target looking", domain: [0, 1] }
      : { label: "Reaction time (msec)", type: log_age ? "log" : "linear" },
    color: { legend: true, label: "Dataset" },
    marks: [
      Plot.line(longData, {
        x: "age", y: "value", z: "subject", stroke: "dataset",
        strokeOpacity: 0.25, strokeWidth: 0.8,
      }),
      Plot.dot(longData, {
        x: "age", y: "value", fill: "dataset", r: 2, fillOpacity: 0.6,
        tip: true, title: (d) =>
          `${d.dataset}\nage ${d.age} mo\n${measure}: ${
            isAcc ? d.value.toFixed(3) : Math.round(d.value) + " ms"}`,
      }),
      Plot.linearRegressionY(longData, {
        x: (d) => (log_age ? Math.log(d.age) : d.age), y: "value",
        stroke: "#111827", strokeWidth: 2.5,
      }),
      ...(isAcc ? [Plot.ruleY([0.5], { strokeDasharray: "4 4" })] : []),
    ],
  });
}
```

The black line is a pooled linear fit (in log age when the log axis is on);
per-child lines are the raw trajectories.

### Change per child

```{ojs long-delta}
{
  const bySubj = d3.group(longData, (d) => d.subject);
  const deltas = [];
  for (const [s, g] of bySubj) {
    if (g.length < 2) continue;
    const first = g[0], last = g[g.length - 1];
    if (last.age === first.age) continue;
    deltas.push({
      subject: s, dataset: first.dataset,
      age_first: first.age, age_last: last.age,
      slope: (last.value - first.value) / (last.age - first.age),
    });
  }
  return Plot.plot({
    width, height: 420,
    x: { label: measure === "Accuracy"
      ? "Change in accuracy per month" : "Change in RT per month (msec)" },
    y: { label: "Children" },
    color: { legend: true, label: "Dataset" },
    marks: [
      Plot.rectY(deltas, Plot.binX({ y: "count" },
        { x: "slope", fill: "dataset", opacity: 0.7 })),
      Plot.ruleX([0], { strokeDasharray: "4 4" }),
      Plot.ruleX([d3.median(deltas, (d) => d.slope)], { stroke: "#111827" }),
    ],
  });
}
```

First-to-last-session change per child; the solid line marks the median.
